Get a dataframe of FVS errors/warnings associated with each stand

get_FVS_messages.Rd

Get a dataframe of FVS errors/warnings associated with each stand

Usage

get_FVS_messages(out_dir = getwd(), out_db, stand_df)

Arguments

out_dir

Character string. Location of the output database. Defaults to working directory.

out_db

Character string. Name of the FVS output database. Defaults to 'FVSOut.db', matching the default in write_FVS_key().

stand_df

Dataframe. Stand information for stands run through FVS. Errors will only be reported for stands that appear in this dataframe. Requires a column named "STAND_ID" (matching STDIDENT passed to write_FVS_files).

Value

Dataframe. Columns: Stand ID; any additional stand information that is in stand_df; warncd, the FVS warning code that can be looked up in FVS documentation; warn_type, which categorizes FVS warning codes into 'Keyword' warnings (codes 1, 4, or 16), 'Forest Bounds' warnings (code 3), 'Insufficient Trees' warnings (code 8), 'Plot Counts' (code 9), 'Hab Type' (short for habitat type; code 14, 23, and any between 32-35), 'High tree count' (code 40), 'Stocking' (code 41), and 'Other' (any other codes).
